question: Which of the following words is a synonym of 'Evanescent'?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Fleeting)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Evanescent"** means something that is fleeting, vanishing, or lasting for only a very short time. (क्षणभंगुर)

 
 
• **Example:** The beauty of a sunset is evanescent, fading away as quickly as it appears.
 
 
 
• **"Fleeting"** refers to something that passes swiftly or is short-lived. (क्षणिक)
 
 
• **Example:** Our happiness was fleeting, as the storm disrupted the celebrations.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Evanescent" and "Fleeting" are synonymous, as both describe something that is temporary or transitory.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Fleeting)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exemplary** (आदर्श): Deserving to be imitated or serving as a model of excellence.

 
 
• **Example:** Her exemplary behavior inspired everyone in the team.
 
 
 
• **Imitation** (नक़ल): The act of copying someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The child's drawing was an imitation of the original artwork.
 
 
 
• **Delicious** (स्वादिष्ट): Pleasing to the taste or highly enjoyable.
 
 
• **Example:** The chocolate cake was so delicious that everyone asked for seconds.
